name: Marie light
ingredients_raw: Refined wheat flour (Maida) (66.6%), Sugar, Refined palm oil, Invert syrup, Milk solids, Raising agents (INS 503 (ii), INS 500 (ii)], lodized salt, Nature identical flavouring substances, Flour treatment agent (INS 223), Emulsifier (Diacetyltartaric and fatty acid esters of glycerol (from refined sunflower oil and palm oil)], Artificial flavouring substances (Milk, Vanilla), Mineral, Colour (INS 150d) and Vitamins.
